verdict.rationale: Companies House's public pages document a keyless entry path for the register: you can search by company name, number or officer name, view company data and documents, and use the name availability checker, with no account mentioned. The GOV.UK guidance layer above it is also served keylessly. The filing flows themselves (filing accounts, changing the registered office) are listed without any documented account-free or company-number-only entry, and identity verification is being rolled out across the register's write paths, so the founder's core filing flow is not shown to be keyless. Missing for 10: documented account-free or company-number-plus-authentication-code entry into the online filing flows, a clear statement of which filing steps need no sign-in, and hands-on corroboration of starting a filing without an account.
